title: Flash PD-SSM: Memory-Optimized Structured Sparse State-Space Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.19150v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: State-space models (SSMs) face a fundamental trade-off between efficiency and expressivity that is mainly dictated by the structure of the model's transition matrix. Unstructured transition matrices enable maximal expressivity, as measured by their ability to model finite-state automaton (FSA) transitions, but come at a prohibitively high compute and memory cost. In contrast, most structured transition matrix forms are highly efficient both in runtime and memory consumption, but suffer from limited expressivity. Building on recent work on structured sparse SSMs, we propose PD-SSM, a novel SSM that achieves comparable throughput to widely-used structured SSMs with significantly better expressivity guarantees. translated_title: Flash PD-SSM：内存优化的结构化稀疏状态空间模型
translated_abstract: 状态空间模型（SSM）面临着效率与表达能力之间的根本性权衡，这主要由模型转移矩阵的结构决定。非结构化的转移矩阵能够实现最大化的表达能力（以其对有限状态自动机（FSA）转移的建模能力来衡量），但其计算和内存成本过高。相比之下，大多数结构化的转移矩阵形式在运行时间和内存消耗方面都非常高效，但表达能力有限。基于近期关于结构化稀疏SSM的研究工作，我们提出了PD-SSM，这是一种新颖的状态空间模型，其吞吐量与广泛使用的结构化SSM相当，同时具有显著更优的表达能力保证。PD-SSM维护一组可训练的结构化稀疏矩阵，并在每个时间步从中离散地选择一个矩阵，从而实现与非结构化矩阵同等的FSA表达能力，同时保持高效。
tldr: 提出了一种新颖的状态空间模型PD-SSM，通过在每个时间步从一组可训练的结构化稀疏矩阵中离散选择一个矩阵，在保持与主流结构化SSM相当的吞吐量的同时，实现了与非结构化转移矩阵相当的表达能力。
en_tdlr: PD-SSM is a novel state-space model that achieves FSA expressiveness at the level of unstructured matrices by discretely selecting one matrix from a trainable set of structured sparse matrices at each time-step, while maintaining throughput comparable to widely-used structured SSMs.
